text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayy ayyyyy☆ See ya, bestie! Mud party 
Fooooooooo!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Not on my watch, bucko! I was here first★ 
Hey hey weeeey!☆"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOOOOOH!?

A forbidden contest for the lead down the 
long final stretch of Tokyo Racecourse. 
And—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

Mejiro Palmer got the crowd completely 
hyped up, and on top of that, she 
delivered real results.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahaha! Palmer-chin, you're covered 
in mud! ★ Totally plastered, that's 
hilarious~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Helios, you're the red bean paste 
here! Peak deliciousness! Ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
W-What is with these two...? They are on 
an entirely different level, even compared 
to Takarazuka...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
We totally got overshadowed, huh... With a 
duo running like that, can you blame 
'em...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I was running too, you know. Did I 
just get picked out or something~?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Truly—an ironclad friendship. To see it 
through this far."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Having a bestie is the absolute best! 
Running can be so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Geez, blew everything right out of the 
water, huh! Thanks to that, it was so much 
fun...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Same here! Pains and exhaustion don't 
mean a thing♪ As long as I'm running with 
Palmer."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well, 2000m is an absolute breeze for me★ 
Which means―!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Come on, say thanks to the audience for 
watching!

When Mejiro Palmer stepped up to the outer 
fence—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
“The Tenno Sho (Autumn)—!! Awesome, I'm 
totally hyped!! Even though I was shaking 
in my boots before.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right now, it's love! Total love! Tokyo is 
the best!! WOOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

Just like the mud splattered all over her, 
Mejiro Palmer bathed in the roar of the 
crowd—looking genuinely happy from the 
bottom of her heart.
And then night fell—

We decided to finalize the details for the 
ultimate battle of the besties duo to cap 
off the year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, our final race goal is, after 
all...!
choice_data_list: The "Arima Kinen" is the only choice.

The "Arima Kinen" is definitely the only 
choice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right? A truly epic final festival race! 
That's where we've gotta hype things up to 
the absolute max!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"So that's where it hurts! Knew it! 2,500 
meters is, like, kinda rough, ngl~!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well, it'll work out somehow, right? We've 
got infinite ∞ vibrations going on! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Are you really okay, Helios?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totes♪ Say what you want, we've still got 
all the passion in the world☆

Or depending on the pace, she really might 
hold out. There are times when milers pull 
off a win, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The "Arima Kinen"... What I want to show 
at the Arima Kinen is our friendship...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: —That might not be all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I haven't shown it yet. What McQueen and 
Ryan have been showing all this time. In 
other words...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What must be loved... How I ought to face 
the Mejiro family.
choice_data_list: To face what it means to be a Mejiro?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yup! After running away, running, and 
relentlessly running from the Mejiros... 
what did I find, and what kind of 
Umamusume did I become...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna bring that answer to the Arima 
Kinen! Right along with my party-people 
soul!
